description: The second supply chain: medicines and the people who dispense them. Returns published workforce indicators — vacancy rate by role and region, GPhC registrant counts, pharmacy network change by region, and shortage designation status — newest period first. Optionally filter by metric, role and/or region (filters combine; omit all for the full ledger). Not a jobs board: no listings, no applications, no salary benchmarking — observed aggregate data only, provenance on every row.

metric.description: Restrict to one indicator. Omit for every metric currently populated.

region.description: An exact ICS name (vacancy rate) or Health-and-Wellbeing-Board name (pharmacy count / network change). Omit for every region.

role.description: e.g. "PHARMACIST" or "PHARMACY_TECHNICIAN". Omit for every role.

name: workforce_stats
